source_name: On the practical CPAD security of “exact” and threshold FHE schemes and libraries
requirement: Enforce systematic addition of smudging noise with proper standard deviation in threshold FHE implementations to prevent CPAD attacks.
evidence_quote: Hence, smudging noise addition with the proper σct and λ-dependent standard deviation should be used in a systematic way, and not be made optional by any library implementing the threshold homomorphic encryption scheme specified in [27].

source_name: On the practical CPAD security of “exact” and threshold FHE schemes and libraries
requirement: Ensure noise smudging is not optional in FHE threshold scheme implementations to act as an effective countermeasure against CPAD adversaries.
evidence_quote: As a consequence, noise smudging must not be optional in FHE threshold scheme implementations.

requirement: Integrate noise deviation monitoring and blocked decryption into the cryptosystem specification to prevent CPAD attackers from working around limits.
evidence_quote: Note that noise deviation monitoring and blocked decryption thus become part of the cryptosystem specification and, as such, a CPAD attacker cannot work around them.
